---
description: Prepare a private interview plan for a local job application.
---

# Prepare Interview Plan

Read `AGENTS.md`, local `AboutMe.md`, `toolbox/.job-search/skills/cv-package/SKILL.md`, and `Job-Applications/[company]/job.txt`. Select the same stable profile lens used by the package, or choose one by comparing all three lenses against explicit evidence when none is recorded. Create or refresh `prep.md` in the same company folder with:

- a supported 90-second introduction aligned to the selected profile;
- a concise “Why this company?” and “Why this role?” answer;
- requirement-to-evidence mapping and genuine gaps;
- a story bank that separates personal actions from team outcomes;
- likely role, technical, behavioral, and seniority questions;
- questions for the employer and a preparation checklist;
- a 30/60/90-day outline only for a genuinely leadership-oriented target.

For leadership targets, distinguish technical leadership, team direction, mentorship, formal people management, recruiting, budget ownership, and organization design. Do not invent facts, upgrade the candidate's title, submit applications, or modify inputs.
